reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is a user-facing web UI enhancement: it adds a side chat panel to DeepSeek Harness, opened from the right edge, and wires it to the existing conversational context (project and session) for alternate chat interaction in parallel with the main chat. It is therefore best classified as navigation-panel/navigation UX rather than project analysis or automation tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的侧边聊天插件，在界面右侧边缘悬停即可打开独立对话栏，并在侧边栏中进行上下文相关聊天。
summaries.en: This is a side-chat plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that opens a dedicated sidebar conversation from the right edge and provides context-aware chat interaction.

capabilities: Provides a secondary side chat panel in the web UI
Injects project and conversation context into side-chat interactions
Supports streaming replies and model/effort controls inside the panel

reasons.code: README describes a hover-open side chat panel in the DeepSeek Harness web interface for parallel chatting.
README states each reply injects project root and git branch context and keeps recent 12-message session context.
README lists model/effort switching and stream output with optional reasoning block in the side chat UI.
package.json declares web platform client injection fields and bundle wiring for host/client plugin loading.
